adapter.terms: Kaspi's merchant API is SELLER-side: it manages the orders customers placed with your Kaspi.kz shop and uploads your products. There is no sourcing/purchasing API.

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe reads the product-import JSON schema, which requires a valid X-Auth-Token.

get_order.note: GET /v2/orders?filter[orders][code]={id}: `id` is the order NUMBER (attribute code) of a customer order placed with your shop. status is APPROVED_BY_BANK, ACCEPTED_BY_MERCHANT, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, CANCELLING, KASPI_DELIVERY_RETURN_REQUESTED or RETURNED; totalPrice is in tenge; dates are epoch milliseconds (creation_date_ms). The order entries are at /v2/orders/{uid}/entries (not mapped).

not_offered.list_products: The goods API only uploads products (POST /products/import) and reads import results, categories and attributes; there is no call that lists the shop's catalogue.
not_offered.get_product: No product read endpoint in the goods API (import schema, classification attributes/values, import status only).
not_offered.quote_shipping: No shipping-rate endpoint; delivery costs appear on the order (deliveryCostForSeller).
not_offered.create_order: Seller-side API: customers order on kaspi.kz; the API accepts, cancels and completes those orders but cannot place one.
not_offered.track: No tracking-events endpoint; Kaspi Доставка waybills are generated through order state changes and the order carries only state/plannedDeliveryDate.
